'''Broo's Legacy''' is a surface Engineer base in the '''[[Muang]]''' system, and the workshop of '''[[Broo Tarquin]]'''.<ref name="inara-broos-legacy">[https://inara.cz/elite/station/52402/ Broo's Legacy in Muang — Station], Inara.</ref>

== Location ==

* '''System:''' [[Muang]]
* '''Body:''' Muang 5 a
* '''Landing pad:''' Large
* '''Permit required:''' No<ref name="inara-broos-legacy" />
* '''Government:''' Workshop <small>(Colony economy)</small><ref name="inara-broos-legacy" />

== Engineer ==

Broo's Legacy is operated by '''[[Broo Tarquin]]'''. Broo is reached through a referral from [[Hera Tani]] — see [[Broo Tarquin]] for the full discovery, invitation, and unlock requirements to access his workshop.

== Station Services ==

Broo's Legacy offers a commodity market, outfitting, rearmament, refuelling, repairs, shipyard services, black market, contacts, Fleet Carrier administration, interstellar factors, a material trader, and a technology broker, in addition to Broo's Engineering workshop.<ref name="inara-broos-legacy" />
